title: Bind split mutable incumbent entrypoint provenance

incident_reproduction_analysis.cause: The clean 0305c861 candidate was aborted because live PID 1393542 had cwd /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root while its configured supervisor_command executed /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/command-runtimes/5877b64425c8d6aede147d6cbbc6fbb9e228c259/.orchestrator/supervisor.py. The promotion preflight failed on ValueError('Mutable incumbent argv does not bind its exact cwd entrypoint').
incident_reproduction_analysis.repair: Added explicit descriptor-bound split-entrypoint provenance capture for legacy mutable incumbents. The operator binds PID/starttime/executable/full argv/live config, the cwd and argv-derived entrypoint root as separate descriptor identities, path component chains, device/inode/mode, Git HEAD/tree/remote/accepted-dev ancestry, and launch-source byte identity. Both roots must prove the same repo (ajoe734/pantheon) and identical commit/tree. Relative/repeated entrypoints, symlink substitution, path traversal, dirty trees, and root races remain strictly fail-closed. Rollback materializes a separately clean immutable checkout from the accepted commit/tree.

safety_and_coherence_invariants.split_root_provenance: When cwd and entrypoint_root differ for a legacy mutable incumbent, both roots are validated independently for Git HEAD, tree, remote URL/slug (ajoe734/pantheon), accepted origin/dev ancestry, cleanliness, and governed launch source byte equality (sha256/byte_length). Any mismatch aborts immediately.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.strict_rejection_boundaries: Relative entrypoints, multiple supervisor.py arguments, symlinks/path traversal in entrypoint path or root, dirty tracked files, untracked/ignored debris outside allowlist, commit/tree mismatches between roots, and launch source byte drift are rejected.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.clean_rollback_materialization: Rollback launches use a separately materialized 100% clean immutable checkout from the descriptor-bound accepted commit/tree in command-runtimes/. Neither dirty live root is ever relaunched from or mutated.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.launch_identity: Governed launch source contracts, config CAS, process signalling, -B / PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, 3-loop postchecks, and promotion lock boundaries remain intact.

no_live_rollout_boundary: This task is source-only. No live config edits, direct process signals, live runtime promotions, candidate deletions, canonical state edits, or fleet scheduling changes were performed.
